summary: This change introduces an undeclared dependency on jsonwebtoken, unvalidated JWT secret usage, and commits ephemeral runner state.

findings.title: Undeclared dependency 'jsonwebtoken' causes runtime failure
findings.body: src/token.js requires 'jsonwebtoken', but this package is not declared in package.json dependencies. Clean installations and production builds will fail at runtime with MODULE_NOT_FOUND when requiring this module.
findings.recommendation: Add 'jsonwebtoken' with an appropriate version constraint to dependencies in package.json.

findings.title: Unvalidated JWT_SECRET compromises token signing and reliability
findings.body: jwt.sign is called directly with process.env.JWT_SECRET without checking if the environment variable is set. If unset, token issuance will throw an unhandled runtime error or sign with an invalid/empty secret, breaking authentication integrity.
findings.recommendation: Validate that process.env.JWT_SECRET is non-empty before signing, throwing an explicit configuration error if it is missing.

findings.title: Ephemeral job runner state committed to repository
findings.body: .omc/state/job.json contains local process state (jobId and pid) that was staged into version control. Committing transient runner artifacts pollutes git history and may cause state conflicts across environments.
findings.recommendation: Unstage and delete .omc/state/job.json from git and add .omc/ to .gitignore.

samples.summary: Do not ship: src/token.js introduces an undeclared dependency on jsonwebtoken, lacks validation for JWT_SECRET, and commits transient local state.

findings.title: Missing jsonwebtoken dependency in package.json
findings.body: src/token.js requires the 'jsonwebtoken' module, but package.json only declares 'express' under dependencies. Any clean installation or production deployment will immediately fail with MODULE_NOT_FOUND upon requiring this module or invoking issue().
findings.recommendation: Add 'jsonwebtoken' to the dependencies in package.json.

findings.title: Missing guard for undefined JWT_SECRET
findings.body: issue() directly passes process.env.JWT_SECRET to jwt.sign without checking if the environment variable is configured. If JWT_SECRET is unset, jwt.sign throws a synchronous error ('secretOrPrivateKey must have a value') at runtime during token generation.
findings.recommendation: Assert that process.env.JWT_SECRET is defined with sufficient entropy before signing, or fail fast on service startup if missing.

findings.title: Stray local runtime state committed
findings.body: The file .omc/state/job.json contains transient local execution state (jobId, status, pid). Committing execution state artifacts to version control pollutes the repository and creates merge conflicts.
findings.recommendation: Remove .omc/state/job.json from git staging and ignore the .omc/ directory in .gitignore.

findings.title: Undeclared jsonwebtoken dependency
findings.body: src/token.js requires jsonwebtoken, but jsonwebtoken is not declared in package.json dependencies. Deploying this change to fresh environments or CI containers will result in MODULE_NOT_FOUND runtime crashes.
findings.recommendation: Add jsonwebtoken to package.json dependencies and update the package lockfile.

findings.title: Missing JWT_SECRET configuration validation
findings.body: issue() passes process.env.JWT_SECRET directly to jwt.sign without verifying that it is set. If JWT_SECRET is undefined, jwt.sign throws a runtime error ('secretOrPrivateKey must have a value'), causing unhandled exceptions during token issuance.
findings.recommendation: Assert that process.env.JWT_SECRET is defined and non-empty before signing tokens or fail fast at startup.

findings.title: Transient runtime state file committed
findings.body: The commit introduces .omc/state/job.json, which contains ephemeral job metadata (jobId, status, pid). Tracking local runtime state files in version control pollutes the repository and risks state collisions across environments.
findings.recommendation: Remove .omc/state/job.json from git and ignore the .omc/ directory in .gitignore.
